updates.new_facts: Elizah fights hybrids, gets impaled by a spear, continues fighting with the spear through his torso, and has a close intimate and fighting dynamic with Nyxia.
updates.quote: A spear punches straight through his chest. The force lifts him off his feet. The world snaps sideways— —and he slams against the wall, impaled, hanging there.

updates.new_facts: Aariz Maddox joins Samuel and Nyxia at the abandoned hospital to hunt hybrids and helps de-escalate fights.
updates.quote: Aariz Maddox lands in a crouch, too light for his size, eyes already scanning.

updates.new_facts: Stitch is associated with bodies of overdosed victims who took too much borrowed power.
updates.quote: Nyxia kneels. Touches his wrist. Cold. Her jaw tightens. Nyxia (quiet, bitter) “...Stitch.”

timeline_events.title: Ambush in the Dark Street
timeline_events.description: Elizah is ambushed by a group of hybrids on a dark street and is eventually impaled by a spear thrown by heavy figures.
timeline_events.quote: The street erupts. Shadows drop from rooftops. Metal claws scrape concrete. Broken breathing fills the air—wet, uneven, wrong.

timeline_events.title: Hospital Investigation and Ambush
timeline_events.description: Nyxia and Samuel investigate an abandoned hospital filled with dead bodies, followed by an ambush of smart hybrids.
timeline_events.quote: The corridor stretches long and hollow, ceiling cracked, paint peeling in strips like shedding skin. Spiderwebs hang from corners like funeral veils

timeline_events.title: Clash in the Central Hall
timeline_events.description: Elizah returns with a spear through his chest to fight alongside Nyxia, leading to an intense confrontation between Elizah and Samuel.
timeline_events.quote: Elizah walks like none of this matters. Like pain is an inconvenience he hasn’t decided to acknowledge yet. He stops beside Nyxia.
